name: LingBot Enhanced Depth Filter
summary: LingBot Enhanced Depth Filter is Orbbec’s licensed SDK filter based on the spatial-perception model co-developed with RobbyAnt. It combines color and aligned depth frames to fill holes, reduce noise and improve object edges for robot manipulation. The filter runs on supported NVIDIA Jetson systems with compatible Gemini 330-series cameras and a valid device license.

description.en: LingBot Enhanced Depth Filter is Orbbec’s licensed SDK filter based on the spatial-perception model co-developed with RobbyAnt. The filter runs on supported NVIDIA Jetson systems with compatible Gemini 330-series cameras and a valid device license.

sources.title: OrbbecSDK_v2/docs/tutorial/enhanced_depth_filter.md at main · orbbec/OrbbecSDK_v2 · GitHub
sources.quote:
Requirements
NVIDIA Jetson running JetPack 6.2 (Linux ARM64);
a supported Gemini 330 series camera with a valid LingBot-Depth License;
CUDA Runtime 12;
TensorRT 10.3 Runtime;
the EnhancedDepthFilter extension and matching
model.sm4
from the same OrbbecSDK release.
The filter requires a frameset containing Color and Depth frames after D2C alignment. Both software D2C and hardware D2C are supported.
Supported configurations:
D2C target resolution:
640x480
,
1280x720
, or
1280x800
;
color format:
RGB
;
depth format:
Y10
,
Y11
,
Y12
,
Y14
,
Y16
, or
Z16
.

specs.label: Depth alignment
specs.value: D2C aligned color/depth frames; software or hardware D2C
